nodes.name: Supramolecular zwitterionic hydrogel electrolytes fabrication
nodes.procedure: A family of all-round supramolecular zwitterionic hydrogel electrolytes (SZHEs) with built-in fast ion shuttles, in which a noncovalent self-assembled supramolecular zwitterionic reorganizable network was introduced in cellulose nanofiber (CNF)-reinforced covalently cross-linked polyacrylic acid (PAA) network in the presence of ZnSO4/EG electrolyte. Five representative zwitterions (betaine, dimethylglycine (DMG), L-proline, trimethylamine oxide (TMAO), and sarcosine (SS)) were selected for the polymerization of acrylic acid (AA) under UV light.

nodes.description: Zn corrosion evaluation via Tafel analysis
